title: India: Size and Location
subtitle: Understanding India's Geographical Placement and Dimensions
subject: Social Science
author: Shine Academy EduOS AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the latitudinal and longitudinal extent of India.
Analyze India's geographical location in relation to the world.
Explain the significance of India's central location at the head of the Indian Ocean.
Recognize the neighboring countries of India.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the geographical coordinates, size, and strategic location of India on the globe.
common_misconceptions: Misunderstanding why Indian Standard Time (IST) is chosen at 82°30'E.
Thinking the Tropic of Cancer passes through all states.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with lat/long, ask them to imagine horizontal rungs of a ladder (latitudes) and vertical long hair (longitudes).
